theorem lg_target (a b c : ℚ) (h₁ : a + b = 5) (h₂ : b + c = 7) (h₃ : a + c = 6) : a = 2 := by
  have h_sum : a + b + c = 9 := by
    rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
    simp [add_add_add_left, add_assoc]
  have h_b : b = 3 := by
    rw [h_sum, h₃]
    simp [sub_eq_sub_right, add_sub_add]
  rw [h_b, h₁]
  simp
